Subject: Mistral Health — Implementation action plan, owners & checkpoints

Hi Avery / Jordan / Mistral team,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — really appreciate the clarity on the prioritization of the triage workflows and the requirement for an audit window on data retention. Per our discussion I put together a concise mutual action plan (attached) with milestone owners and proposed dates so we can align on a go-live runway that balances your compliance checks and our delivery cadence.

Top-level proposal:
- Phased rollout: sandbox validation (2 weeks) -> pilot (4 weeks) -> production cutover (1 week)
- Suggested go-live target: June 14, 2027 (production traffic begins)
- Engineering handoff: Redwood infra + Mistral eng sync weekly until pilot green

I've attached a draft SOW and the MAP spreadsheet that maps responsibility by milestone. Can you review the owners/dates and confirm any legal/PROC constraints we should bake in (e.g., PO timeline, security evidence deadlines)?

Next steps I propose this week:
1) You confirm internal approvers and procurement timeline (Avery / Procurement) — by Thu 15 Apr
2) Redwood to finalize SOW (Rafael + Marissa) — by Fri 16 Apr
3) Technical kickoff & data access checklist meeting — Tue 20 Apr (30–45 min)

If those dates look tight, tell us which anchors we should move.

Cheers,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference | rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Rafael — this looks like a solid starting point. Quick items from our side:

- Procurement: we need a finalized SOW + anticipated monthly spend to open a PO. Procurement (copied) says they can get to a PO in ~10 business days once they have the SOW and a primary contact for billing.
- Security: our security team requires a completed questionnaire and evidence of SOC2 Type II or a security attestation. Can you confirm where we are on that?
- Data access: for sandbox validation we need a temporary dataset with EHR redactions — do you have a checklist for required fields and a sample upload procedure?

Also — the June 14 target looks possible, but it depends on procurement lead times and the security sign-off. If procurement is delayed, we may need to push pilot to late June.

I'll review the MAP workbook and get back with owners by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Avery
Head of Platform Integrations | Mistral Health

Hi Avery — thanks for the quick review and for flagging procurement/security constraints. I pulled the MAP into a sprint-style checklist and added concrete owners and acceptance criteria. Summary below (full workbook attached):

1) Sandbox validation (Owner: Monica Patel, Customer Success) — Apr 26 to May 9
   - Deliverables: test dataset ingest, basic prompt templates, latency and token-cost baseline report
   - Acceptance: successful sample conversations (10 health workflows) and security checklist completed

2) Pilot (Owner: Marissa Cole, CS + Rafael for product decisions) — May 10 to June 6
   - Deliverables: pilot subscription, full integrations to triage queue, monitoring dashboards, baseline SLOs
   - Acceptance: <2% error rate on triage classification and signed pilot acceptance by Mistral PM

3) Production cutover (Owner: Ben Carter, Ops) — June 7 to June 14
   - Deliverables: production keys, rate limits, on-call rotation, rollback plan
   - Acceptance: load smoke tests passed and go/no-go checklist signed by both sides

Key dependencies and gating items:
- Procurement: needs SOW + monthly estimate (Rafael) — ETA for PO from Mistral procurement will determine pilot start
- Security evidence: Redwood provided completed questionnaire attached. We will schedule a 30-min review with your security SME on Apr 22 (request: Jordan or security contact)
- Data provisioning: Monica will send a data ingestion checklist and a stub S3 location for the sandbox by Apr 21

Proposed cadence: weekly 30-minute syncs (Thursdays 10am PT) until pilot completion. I'll own meeting facilitation and the action tracker.

Rafael — I updated the SOW to reflect the staged billing model (sandbox = no charge, pilot = evaluation rate, production = committed rate). See SOW_v1 attached. Ben — please confirm Ops readiness window for June 7–14.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
